title: Chapter 112
text:
After getting the item, Han Xiao immediately went to find Bennett. Ever since the mercenaries and assassins moved into the villa, Bennett and Wang Yuan often appeared, so everyone knew that they lived on the top floor.

The brown-glazed wooden stairs of the villa had a calming fragrance. Han Xiao walked up to the third floor and knocked on Bennett's door.

"Sit anywhere you like."

Bennett was holding a cup of green medicinal tea. After opening the door, he sat on the sofa and looked at Han Xiao with a smile. He had a good impression of Han Xiao, who was the first to recognize him, so he asked, "Why are you looking for me? Oh right, let's not talk first. I made a pot of medicinal tea, do you want to try? "He said as he waved the cup in his hand.

The medicinal tea in the cup was so thick that it almost couldn't dissolve. It was a thick green color, and there were strange bubbles rolling around.

Han Xiao pursed his lips. He couldn't resist the urge to complain. He pointed at the medicinal tea and said weakly, "Then, what's the price?"

“？”

Bennett's face was full of confusion. He didn't understand what he was saying.

Han Xiao coughed and pulled the topic back on track, "I want to learn some combat skills from you."

Bennett didn't know whether to laugh or cry, "Didn't I already reject … Eh, this is the Silver Warden's Hidden Blade?"

The Silver Warden's Hidden Blade was made in a country that had already perished. That country's cold weapon manufacturing skills had been passed down for hundreds of years. Every finished product was exquisite. There were only a hundred or so of this type of hidden blade left in the world. The spine of the blade was engraved with tadpole-like inscriptions. Each blade was unique, and when the inscriptions were connected together, it was a long poem from a perished country. It was very classic.

Bennett stared at the hidden blade. His eyes revealed his fondness, but he didn't reach out to take it. Instead, he looked at Han Xiao and said in surprise, "You want to give it to me? How did you know that I like to collect antique weapons? You really are my admirer! "

"I …" Han Xiao was speechless. His actions were indeed very ambiguous, and there was no way to explain it. He thought to himself, "As long as I can learn the skill, it's fine if it's a misunderstanding. Who knows, I might even be able to get closer."

After receiving the Silver Warden's Hidden Blade, Bennett couldn't bear to put it down. However, he felt a little troubled. Han Xiao had given him a gift that was very much to his liking. Furthermore, he seemed to be a hardcore fan. (Han Xiao: As long as you're happy.) He felt bad about rejecting Han Xiao's request.

"Then promise him."

Bennett thought for a moment, raised his head, and said to Han Xiao with a smile, "I'm willing."

Han Xiao had goosebumps all over his body. He hurriedly took a step back and put his hands in front of his body. His eyes were vigilant and ready for battle.

"What are you thinking?! I said I'm willing to teach you some techniques. "Bennett facepalmed.

Han Xiao let out a sigh of relief and pretended to be angry. "Can you finish your words?!"

"… You should clean up the garbage in your brain." Bennett didn't know whether to laugh or cry. He shook his head, thought for a while, and decided on which skill to teach.

"When I was still weak in my early years, I explored a lot of combat techniques on my own. One of them allowed me to counterattack many times. I named it [Flaming Will].

"The brain is a limiter that protects the human body. If this limiter is removed, an ordinary person without any training can also burst out with extraordinary strength. However, the sequelae are very serious. During a dangerous situation, I coincidentally removed the limiter. After exploring, I found a way to temporarily remove the limiter in battle without harming the body …"

Bennett started to explain the principle and carefully guided Han Xiao on the essentials.

Bennett Anderson (LV60) has taught you [Flaming Will]. Your INT is over 100, and you have met the learning requirement. Current learning progress is 3%.

The teaching lasted from morning to afternoon. With the pleasant notification sound from the interface, Han Xiao finally understood this ability.

[Flaming Will LV1: General Skill]

Remark: When Bennett Anderson was young, he was once training in the Arctic Plains of the Northern Continent. He was surrounded by seven Northern Leopard Bears. A Northern Leopard Bear's size is comparable to a small tank. Believe me, no one wants to hear their roars. It usually means that they have been targeted by this group of predators in the Arctic Plains. Their thick and tough skin and muscles are so thick that even submachine guns can't penetrate them.

At that time, Bennett only had a dagger with him. He didn't even have a hot weapon. In a life-threatening situation, Bennett learned this skill. He used a simple iron dagger to create a lethality comparable to a high-frequency chopper!

This skill has both active and passive effects.

Active Cooldown Time: 10 minutes

Passive Effect: When HP is lower than 20%, this skill will be activated once. Passive Cooldown Time: 30 minutes (Does not overlap with the active cooldown. Is calculated separately)

Remark: The damage increase is based on the basic attack bonus, which is equivalent to the theoretical damage value. After stacking, the damage reduction will be calculated.

"Awesome." Han Xiao was secretly excited. He had been jealous of this skill for a long time in his previous life. He did not expect that his dream would come true today.

Players had another name for [Flaming Will] — Mini Universe Explosion!

This was a general skill that could be learned by any class. However, the first condition was that one had to have over 100 INT. Secondly, there were only a hundred or so Silver Guardian Hidden Blade in the world. In other words, only a hundred or so people in the Blue Star could learn this skill.

Han Xiao had taken up a position.

[Flaming Will] was a perfect match for his sniping ability. The probability of the damage increase was dependent on Intelligence and Luck. One of these two attributes was strong and the other was weak. If they were neutralized, it would probably become normal.

With [Flaming Will] activated, he would be able to deal at least 1.3 to 1.5 times the damage. If he added in critical hits, sneak attacks, and back sniping, he would be able to fully display the characteristics of a sniper rifle. If he used [Lucky Burst] to trigger a three or even five times increase in damage, the damage would definitely be incomprehensible. In his previous life, Han Xiao had met a player with [Flaming Will] who had destroyed all of his shields with one shot.

This ability had a longer cooldown time and was suitable for the Critical Hit Style where one shot would determine the outcome. There was a branch of the sniper style called Sneak Attack … Cough cough, it was called Sneak Attack Hidden Sniper Style.

The other Locke HOC Sniper Rifle could trigger a sub-class mission. That class happened to lean towards Stealth and Concealment, which formed Han Xiao's idea. This was the idea that popped up in his head when he saw Bennett. Han Xiao was not going to trigger it now. That was a sub-class mission. He felt that he had to complete the Manor Guard Mission first before he had the time.

Seeing how excited Han Xiao was, Bennett was puzzled. "You've learned it?"

"Quickly." Han Xiao smiled.

Bennett was surprised and took a few steps back. "Punch me and see if you've really learned it."

Hearing this, Han Xiao, who had been looking forward to this segment, immediately punched him.

You have used [Flaming Will]. Determining …

Authentication complete. Your next attack will deal 136% of the base damage.

The fist hit Bennett's left cheek. Han Xiao felt like he had hit an indestructible wall that was harder than steel. A bright -1 damage popped up above Bennett's head.

You have entered battle mode.

Based on your level, you can receive the following information.

— —

Bennett Anderson

Level: 60

Profession:?

Attribute:?

Health Points:?

Status: Hidden Injury (All attributes weakened)

Energy:?

Energy Rank:?

Grade: D + (C)

Ability: Lucky Aura — Everything Comes True, Danger Surrounded

Legendary Battle Technique — Every 12 attacks, there is a 40-70% chance of adding a True Damage (this chance is affected by luck).

Remaining unknown.
